title: Dear Virgo: date number three.
old_caption:
Virgo, are you fixing the porch before date three?
It is a date, not a job. Let them pick up a brush and help.

title: Houston weather: hot, then cold.
old_caption:
Hot texts, then three days of silence, then "hey"?
The weather can run hot and cold. Your person shouldn't. Steady is attractive.

title: Houston rule: bring a jacket indoors.
old_caption:
Freezing on a date because the AC is on max?
Cancer notices and hands over the cardigan. Small care is big care.

title: The Katy Freeway has a lot of lanes.
old_caption:
Do you keep switching lanes hoping to get there faster?
Aries learns rushing love does not help. Pick a lane and enjoy the drive.

title: The stars go to a ballgame.
old_caption:
Ever been put on the spot in front of a whole crowd?
These two ask first and go for a high five. Consent is cute.

title: Kolaches or breakfast tacos?
old_caption:
One kolache left on the first date. Who gets it?
Taurus guards it, then splits it. The one who shares the last bite is a keeper.

title: Dear LA.
old_caption:
Is every photo you post taken in perfect light?
Leo learns to lead with who you are. Let them fall for the card first.

title: Houston, we have a…
old_caption:
What if the stars actually landed in your city?
Twelve signs touch down in Houston, fog up in the humidity, and find a match.

title: Leo has a crush.
old_caption:
Rehearsing what to say to your crush, and it's all about you?
Leo's mirror has better advice: lead with a question about them.

title: LIVE from the campaign trail.
old_caption:
Which city should the stars visit next? Gemini and Sag are calling it live.
No numbers, no leader yet. It's still anyone's game.
